confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Marrakech price levels, not from live listings or current menus. Café, local restaurant, and hostel prices are moderately certain. Beer, cocktail, and wine are less certain because licensed venues are limited and prices vary widely. Hotel rates are the least certain because they depend on season, riad versus hotel format, and demand in July. Anchors are USD equivalents of typical local-currency prices.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general price levels in Morocco's mainland tourist cities (Fes, Essaouira, Agadir) and North African Mediterranean tourism markets, adjusted for Marrakech's relatively high accommodation demand. No live data was used.
